flags.detail: The desk renders the last committed collector snapshot plus in-browser REST polling. As of this build the newest snapshot is 2026-11-20T19:38:44+00:00. Browser polling hits the demo API directly; if the browser or the API blocks the request the page says so instead of showing stale numbers as live.
flags.item: Live snapshots are refreshed by a scheduled collector, not a streaming feed

flags.detail: Series such as KXDEMOFUTHOURLY (hourly 'Demo BTC' markets) and KXQUICKSETTLE exist only on the demo exchange for testing. They rank high by volume and are excluded from the tracked/ranked tables here so they are not read as real markets.
flags.item: Some demo series are exchange self-tests and are excluded from tracking

flags.detail: The trade API has no dollar-volume field. The ranking uses volume_fp x notional_value_dollars and is labelled derived on every page. The definition of 'highest dollar amount' remains an open question.
flags.item: 'Highest dollar amount' is derived, not published

flags.detail: p_hat is built from the quoted midpoint, one hour of price momentum and the spread. The formula is published on the page; it is a way to prioritise what to look at and makes no claim about realised returns.
flags.item: The ROI score is a heuristic, not a measured return

flags.detail: Every simulated trade fills as a taker at the candlestick's quoted side price, exits at +$0.10, -$0.10 or resolution, and pays $1 per winning contract per the settlement docs. Exchange fees are not modelled because the demo fee schedule was not verified for this environment.
flags.item: Simulated fills are modelled at quoted prices and fees are not included

flags.detail: No fee schedule for the demo exchange was confirmed from an official Kalshi page during this build, so fees are recorded as 0.00 and labelled, never estimated.
flags.item: Fee model absent (unverified for the demo environment)

flags.detail: Portfolio reads and live demo order entry need a demo API key (KALSHI_DEMO_API_KEY_ID / KALSHI_DEMO_PRIVATE_KEY). They are not present, so the desk runs paper/simulated only: no order is ever sent and no account balance is displayed. Account values are blank, not estimated.
flags.item: No demo API credentials are configured in this repository

flags.detail: Each alert shows an official source link for the price data and a search link for headlines around that timestamp. A headline is never asserted to have caused the move; the page says the association is unverified.
flags.item: News attribution is a link, not a proven cause

flags.detail: 46 contracts have committed candlestick history; others are tracked by quote only. Coverage is stated on the page rather than implied.
flags.item: Candlestick history is limited to the tracked lines

flags.detail: Alerts are only ever produced from committed official candlesticks. Gas, crypto and golf contracts in the archive traded in increments smaller than $0.10 over the collected windows, so they appear on the topic pages with their quotes and candles but with no swing alerts. Nothing is invented to fill the gap; the scheduled collector widens the history over time.
flags.item: Some topics had no committed $0.10 swing during the collected windows

flags.detail: data/latest/candles.json and data/history/ hold demo-exchange payloads. Gas, crypto and golf hourly history in analysis/data/live/candles.json was collected from the production endpoint (api.elections.kalshi.com). Those contracts are copied read-only and carry environment='production' in every table and chart caption so demo and production data are never confused.
flags.item: Some candlestick history comes from the production API archive, labelled

flags.detail: A swing where the exchange reported zero volume in the period is a quote move, not a trade. Those alerts carry a 'no trades in window' badge and are not presented as executed price moves.
WS handshakes require KALSHI-ACCESS-* signature headers, which a static page cannot attach. The desk therefore polls REST and labels the transport.
flags.item: The browser cannot open an authenticated Kalshi WebSocket
